briefings.title: Senators John Fetterman and Dave McCormick: Bipartisanship, Money in DC, Datacenters, Graham Platner
briefings.tldr: Pennsylvania Senators John Fetterman (D) and Dave McCormick (R) advocate for a pragmatic, bipartisan approach to national governance, emphasizing that preserving the Senate filibuster and expanding AI and energy infrastructure are critical to keeping America competitive against China.

briefings.title: John Fetterman on Depression, Vance vs. Rubio, and Why He Won’t Toe the Party Line
briefings.tldr: Senator John Fetterman discusses his recovery from depression and his commitment to bipartisanship, while host Meghan McCain expresses deep alarm over Virginia’s recent redistricting, which she argues effectively disenfranchises Republican voters and signals a dangerous national trend toward extreme gerrymandering.

briefings.title: John Fetterman: 'I'm the Only Democrat in Congress Saying This'
briefings.tldr: Senator John Fetterman (D-PA) positions himself as a "moral clarity" Democrat who rejects the "progressive" label, favoring unapologetic support for Israel, strict border security, and common-sense voter ID laws while criticizing "Trump Derangement Syndrome" (TDS) for paralyzing effective governance.
